import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"]

    df = readings.copy()

    # Row-level rule: bad if value is null, negative, or > 1000
    is_bad = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)
    df["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    # Batch-level aggregates
    batch_stats = df.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"].agg(
        bad_row_count="sum",
        total_rows="count"
    ).reset_index()

    batch_stats["quarantined"] = (batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100) > (batch_stats["total_rows"] * 20)
    batch_stats["batch_reject_pct"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / batch_stats["total_rows"]
    ).round(2)

    df = df.merge(
        batch_stats[["batch_id", "quarantined", "batch_reject_pct"]],
        on="batch_id",
        how="left"
    )

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantined"] == True

    quarantine_df = df.loc[quarantine_mask, ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value", "batch_reject_pct"]].copy()

    non_quarantine = df.loc[~quarantine_mask].copy()

    clean_df = non_quarantine.loc[~non_quarantine["_is_bad"], ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]].copy()
    rejects_df = non_quarantine.loc[non_quarantine["_is_bad"], ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]].copy()

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
